# Katherine Kleyman, Esq.

> Plaintiff-side employment attorney representing employees in New York and California in wrongful termination, retaliation, discrimination, and workplace harassment matters.

Katherine Kleyman is an employment lawyer and former corporate counsel, licensed in New York and California, and a graduate of Fordham University School of Law. She represents workers (not employers) and offers a free case review as well as a paid strategy session for employees who are still employed. Contingency-based representation is available in qualified cases.

Contact: 1-646-583-5001 · 221 Kings Hwy, Brooklyn, NY 11223
Service areas: New York City (Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island), Long Island, Westchester, and across California including Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, and San Jose.
